name: miami
title: Miami
description: Ocean Drive at dusk: art deco hotels with flickering neon fins, swaying palms, cars on the drive and a slow surf under a low sun.

name: tokyo
title: Tokyo
description: Tokyo on a clear night: Tokyo Tower lit among towers of windows, vertical neon signs, a train on a curving elevated line and Mount Fuji on the horizon.

name: new-york
title: New York
description: Manhattan at night from across the East River, with the Empire State and Chrysler buildings, a skyline of lit windows, the Brooklyn Bridge and a ferry.

name: paris
title: Paris
description: The Eiffel Tower glowing gold at blue hour over the Seine, with its sparkle, its beacon, a bateau-mouche and zinc rooftops.

name: london
title: London
description: Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament and Tower Bridge in evening fog over the Thames, with amber lamps and a red bus crossing.

name: dubai
title: Dubai
description: Dubai at golden hour: the Burj Khalifa catching the last sun above a cluster of glass towers, the sail of the Burj Al Arab on the shore, and dunes with sand blowing off their crests.

name: san-francisco
title: San Francisco
description: The Golden Gate Bridge on a foggy morning: orange towers, fog rolling through the strait and under the deck, the city and the Transamerica Pyramid behind, and sailboats on the bay.

name: hong-kong
title: Hong Kong
description: Victoria Harbour at night from Kowloon: towers up the slopes of Victoria Peak, the Bank of China Tower and IFC, a rooftop light show, and a junk and a Star Ferry on the mirrored water.

name: rio
title: Rio de Janeiro
description: Sugarloaf and Corcovado in the late afternoon over Copacabana, with cable cars, breaking surf, the wave-mosaic promenade and frigatebirds.

name: sydney
title: Sydney
description: Sydney Harbour at night: the Opera House lit white, the Harbour Bridge behind it, fireworks bursting over the arch and the whole scene mirrored in the water.
